title: Algebraic descent of sections on an affine chart
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R : I → CommRing a functor, and c an affine limit cone of Spec of R. Fix i, f : Xi → Spec(R_i), and a finitely presented quasi-coherent module M on Xi × Spec(R_i) c.pt. Fix an affine chart V_a of an open cover V of Xi. For some j ≥ i, let U_a be its pullback to Xi × Spec(R_i) Spec(R_j), let p be the limit-to-stage base-change map, let Y be the further pullback chart, g : Y → U_a its chart map, and P the pullback of M to Y. There exists a finitely presented algebraic module Q over Γ(U_a, top) together with an isomorphism Γ(Y, top) tensor over Γ(U_a, top) Q ≅ Γ(P, top), where scalar extension uses g.appTop. No sheaf on U_a is asserted. These are the scheme and base-change conventions of def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions and def-pc-base-change, with finite presentation as in pqf-def-coherent.

source.place: Tag 01ZR first proof, affine case; Algebra Tag 05N7; Modules on Schemes Tag 01I6

proof.text: Use the fixed affine chart ring colimit and iterated-chart sections comparison. The upper tail above i is nonempty and directed. The fixed limit chart is affine by stability of affine morphisms under pullback. Restrict M to it; the proved native pullback finite-presentation instance and affine-sections theorem give finite presentation of its section module N.

Extend N along the inverse colimit ring comparison. Apply exists_finitePresentation_model_of_preorder_colimit to obtain a finitely presented module Q at an upper-tail stage. Extend Q along the stage chart ring isomorphism, which preserves finite presentation.

The compatibility equation of the chart comparison identifies the two scalar-extension ring maps. Compose extendScalarsComp, the extended stage-model isomorphism, and cancellation along q.inv then q.hom (using q.inv_hom_id and extendScalarsId). Extend this comparison along the limit-chart ring isomorphism, then compose with its sections-transport isomorphism. This gives exactly the requested iterated-chart section model.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_affine_chart_sections_model
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (hM : M.IsFinitePresentation) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (V.X a)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
      let Y := (U.pullback₁ p).X a
      let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ p).f a)).obj M
      ∃ Q : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(U.X a, ⊤),
        Module.FinitePresentation Γ(U.X a, ⊤) Q ∧
        Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (U.pullbackHom p a).appTop.hom).obj Q ≅
          ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(P, ⊤))
